title: Bill Runway
user: A person or caregiver who needs to see upcoming invoices, due dates, and cash needed before income arrives, without connecting bank accounts or adopting a full budgeting system.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA for a list of bills/invoices, expected income dates, one-time or recurring due rules, and a timeline that flags an uncovered amount; export a one-page payment run.
constraints: No financial-institution credentials; use decimal-safe currency arithmetic; label forecasts as user-entered planning data, not financial advice.
